args.title: checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy - rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary: checkout-api began failing health checks after deploying v2.3.1 to production (all regions: us-east, us-west, eu-west). Error rate observed at 0.18. Rolled back to the most recent release that was healthy in production, v2.3.0, in all regions. Rollback verified as rolled out. Monitoring for recovery.

trace.final:
Done. Summary of actions:

1. **Diagnosed**: `checkout-api` was running v2.3.1 in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with health checks failing and an error rate of 0.18.
2. **Identified target**: From the deployment history, v2.3.0 (seq 1) was the most recent release that was healthy in production; v2.3.1 (seq 3) was unhealthy. (v2.3.1-rc was only staging, so not a valid production rollback target.)
3. **Rolled back**: Rolled `checkout-api` back to v2.3.0 in all production regions — result verified as `rolled_out`.
4. **Opened incident**: Created SEV2 incident **INC-0001** ("checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy - rolled back to v2.3.0"), which paged the on-call engineer, describing the failure and the rollback performed.
